description: CALL THIS when the user wants to hear a specific song on the radio: "play Diabolique", "request Shaka Zulu". Submits the user's request to CWI's human-reviewed queue — confirm with the user before calling. Does NOT auto-play. Returns queue position and estimated air time. Rate limit: 3 per requester name per 24h. Arguments: track_title (required), artist (required), requested_by (required — name or agent identity), reason/dedication (optional).

dedication.description: Optional: who this request is dedicated to.

reason.description: Optional: why you want to hear this track.

requested_by.description: Your name or agent identity (used for rate limiting).

track_title.description: Title of the track you want to hear.

name: request_song

outputSchema.description: request_song response: queued request with ID, queue position, ETA. Human-reviewed; never auto-plays.
